['OTTO GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Otto GmbH & Co. KG, also known as Otto Group, is a German mail order and e-commerce company based in Hamburg. It operates in more than twenty countries and is primarily focused on retail e-commerce. The company has also expanded into real estate and financial services.

['K\u00fchne + Nagel (AG & Co.) KG '].company_description: Kuehne + Nagel International AG is a global transport and logistics company based in Schindellegi, Switzerland. It provides sea freight and airfreight forwarding, contract logistics, and overland businesses. As of 2022, it has nearly 1,300 offices in 106 countries, with over 78,000 employees.
